mapper.sql: SELECT TO_CHAR(E.BASIC_NO) AS BASIC_NO, TO_CHAR(E.PLAN_NO) AS PLAN_NO, E.TRAIN_TYPE_CODE, GET_GLOBAL_NAME(E.TRAIN_TYPE_CODE, #{lang, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AS TRAIN_TYPE_CODE_NAME, E.COURSE_NAME_CODE, E.TRAIN_FORM_CODE, GET_GLOBAL_NAME(E.TRAIN_FORM_CODE, #{lang, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AS TRAIN_FORM_CODE_NAME, E.TRAIN_ADDRESS, TO_CHAR(E.IMPLE_START_DATE, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS IMPLE_START_DATE, TO_CHAR(E.IMPLE_END_DATE, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS IMPLE_END_DATE, TO_CHAR(E.IMPLE_CLASS_HOUR) AS IMPLE_CLASS_HOUR, TO_CHAR(E.IMPLE_CLASS_UNIT) AS IMPLE_CLASS_UNIT, E.TRAIN_CONTENT, TO_CHAR(E.PERIOD_TIME) AS PERIOD_TIME, TO_CHAR(E.APPLY_END_DATE, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS APPLY_END_DATE, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM EDU_FREE_EMPLOYEE C WHERE C.BASIC_NO = E.BASIC_NO AND C.ACTIVITY = '1' AND C.EVA_RESULT IS NOT NULL) AS STUDENT_EVAL_COUNT, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM EDU_TEACHER_CHECK T WHERE T.BASIC_NO = E.BASIC_NO AND (T.GROOMING IS NOT NULL OR T.ALLSCORE IS NOT NULL)) AS TEACHER_EVAL_COUNT, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM EDU_TRAIN_RESULT R WHERE R.BASIC_NO = E.BASIC_NO AND (R.DIFFICULTY IS NOT NULL OR R.CONTENT_RICH IS NOT NULL OR R.PRACTICABILITY IS NOT NULL OR R.TIME_MODERATE IS NOT NULL)) AS RESULT_COUNT
(SELECT H.EMPID FROM HR_EMPLOYEE H WHERE H.PERSON_ID = #{adminID, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND ROWNUM = 1)
mapper.select:
FROM EDU_BASIC_INFORMATION E WHERE E.ACTIVITY = '1' AND E.CPNY_ID = #{cpnyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
AND UPPER(E.COURSE_NAME_CODE) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{courseName, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) || '%'
AND E.IMPLE_START_DATE >= TO_DATE(#{startDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'DD/MM/YYYY')
AND E.IMPLE_END_DATE <= TO_DATE(#{endDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'DD/MM/YYYY')
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM EDU_PLAN_MANAGER P WHERE P.PLAN_NO = E.PLAN_NO AND INSTR(P.ISNOT_EVALUATE, #{evaluateType, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) > 0)
AND DBMS_LOB.INSTR(',' || E.EVA_TEACHER_EMPID || ',', ',' || || ',') > 0
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM EDU_FREE_EMPLOYEE F WHERE F.BASIC_NO = E.BASIC_NO AND F.ACTIVITY = '1' AND F.EMPID = )
ORDER BY E.CREATE_DATE DESC

, E.DES_DEPARTMENT, E.COM_TEACHER_EMPID, E.COM_TEACHER_NAME, E.EVA_TEACHER_EMPID, E.EVA_TEACHER_NAME, E.PLAN_EMPLOYEE_EMPID, E.PLAN_EMPLOYEE_NAME FROM EDU_BASIC_INFORMATION E WHERE E.BASIC_NO = #{basicNo, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND E.CPNY_ID = #{cpnyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND E.ACTIVITY = '1'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO EDU_BASIC_INFORMATION (BASIC_NO, PLAN_NO, TRAIN_TYPE_CODE, COURSE_NAME_CODE, TRAIN_FORM_CODE, TRAIN_ADDRESS, IMPLE_START_DATE, IMPLE_END_DATE, IMPLE_CLASS_HOUR, IMPLE_CLASS_UNIT, TRAIN_CONTENT, COM_TEACHER_EMPID, COM_TEACHER_NAME, EVA_TEACHER_EMPID, EVA_TEACHER_NAME, PLAN_EMPLOYEE_EMPID, DES_DEPARTMENT, PLAN_EMPLOYEE_NAME, ACTIVITY, CREATE_DATE, CREATED_BY, CREATED_IP, CPNY_ID, PERIOD_TIME, APPLY_END_DATE) VALUES (#{basicNo, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{planNo, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{trainTypeCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{courseNameCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{trainFormCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{trainAddress, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, TO_DATE(#{impleStartDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'DD/MM/YYYY'), TO_DATE(#{impleEndDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'DD/MM/YYYY'), #{impleClassHour, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{impleClassUnit, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{trainContent, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{comTeacherEmpidRaw, jdbcType=CLOB}, #{comTeacherNameRaw, jdbcType=CLOB}, #{evaTeacherEmpidRaw, jdbcType=CLOB}, #{evaTeacherNameRaw, jdbcType=CLOB}, #{planEmployeeEmpidRaw, jdbcType=CLOB}, #{desDepartmentRaw, jdbcType=CLOB}, #{planEmployeeNameRaw, jdbcType=CLOB}, '1', SYSDATE, #{adminID, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{adminIP, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{cpnyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{periodTime, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, TO_DATE(#{applyEndDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'DD/MM/YYYY'))
mapper.update: UPDATE EDU_BASIC_INFORMATION SET IMPLE_START_DATE = TO_DATE(#{impleStartDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'DD/MM/YYYY'), IMPLE_END_DATE = TO_DATE(#{impleEndDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'DD/MM/YYYY'), IMPLE_CLASS_HOUR = #{impleClassHour, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, IMPLE_CLASS_UNIT = #{impleClassUnit, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, TRAIN_CONTENT = #{trainContent, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, EVA_TEACHER_EMPID = #{evaTeacherEmpidRaw, jdbcType=CLOB}, EVA_TEACHER_NAME = #{evaTeacherNameRaw, jdbcType=CLOB}, DES_DEPARTMENT = #{desDepartmentRaw, jdbcType=CLOB}, APPLY_END_DATE = TO_DATE(#{applyEndDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'DD/MM/YYYY'), UPDATE_DATE = SYSDATE, UPDATED_BY = #{adminID, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, UPDATED_IP = #{adminIP, jdbcType=VARCHAR} WHERE BASIC_NO = #{basicNo, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND CPNY_ID = #{cpnyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
UPDATE EDU_PLAN_MANAGER SET ACTIVITY = 2 WHERE PLAN_NO = #{planNo, jdbcType=NUMERIC} AND ACTIVITY = 1
UPDATE EDU_PLAN_MANAGER P SET P.ACTIVITY = 1 WHERE P.PLAN_NO = (SELECT B.PLAN_NO FROM EDU_BASIC_INFORMATION B WHERE B.BASIC_NO = #{basicNo, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AND P.ACTIVITY = 2
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO EDU_FREE_EMPLOYEE (FREE_NO, EMPID, LOCAL_NAME, BASIC_NO, ACTIVITY, CREATE_DATE, CREATED_BY, CREATED_IP, CPNY_ID, FLAG) VALUES (EDU_FREE_EMP_SEQ.NEXTVAL, #{empId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{localName, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{basicNo, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, '1', SYSDATE, #{adminID, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{adminIP, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{cpnyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{flag, jdbcType=VARCHAR})
